company.name: CareRev
company.shortDescription: CareRev is a healthcare staffing marketplace platform that connects health systems and local healthcare professionals.
company.description: Care Revolutions is a marketplace for healthcare staff, an online technology platform where Hospitals and Outpatient facilities can directly access per diem medical staff. No vendors, no agencies, no middlemen. Care Revolutions fill empty shifts faster, lower overall staffing costs, and increase trust and quality of patient care. Hospitals and outpatient facilities book professionals daily to complement their float pool, increase shift fill rates, and maintain safe nurse-to-patient ratios.

productsAndServices.description: A healthcare staffing marketplace that connects hospitals and other care facilities with vetted local W-2 nurses and allied health professionals for on-demand shifts.
productsAndServices.name: CareRev Marketplace

productsAndServices.description: An internal resource pool and workforce planning solution that helps health systems forecast demand, optimize internal float pools, and fill staffing needs with employees before using external labor.
productsAndServices.name: IRP+

productsAndServices.description: A set of workforce management tools for forecasting demand, modeling labor costs, optimizing float pools, monitoring staffing activity, and supporting governance and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: CareRev Enterprise Tools

productsAndServices.description: An integration service that connects CareRev’s on-demand clinician marketplace with vendor management systems, enabling partners to post shifts and access qualified healthcare professionals.
productsAndServices.name: CareRev VMS Integration and Partner Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service for healthcare professionals to create profiles, complete screening and credentialing, find local per diem shifts, manage schedules, and receive payment through the CareRev platform.
productsAndServices.name: Healthcare Professional Shift and Credentialing Service

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $5,254,420, or 9.29% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $8,192,411 to $290,737,279, a 35.49x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 54 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 55 (-5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
